prior_status: The exact overlap decomposition was proved, but its unrestricted conditional address-spectrum payment was shown to contain full FEI. A014 had no complete unbounded-read family with all congestion, label, rank, and root costs controlled.
new_status: A rank-one signed-overlap theorem and a genuine one-point-defect times majority family now give a strict separation: worst read 2^t versus bounded spectral/fractional congestion and FEI constant below four. Independent review remains pending; full FEI remains open.
mathematical_delta: Proved that balanced Boolean spectral rank one forces signed-copy factorization; paid the entire controller entropy explicitly; exhibited k=2^t, fractional congestion=1, rank=1, expected root cost<2, and H<4I.
remaining_obstacle: No stable payment is known for spectral rank greater than one or approximate rank one without recovering the FEI-hard arbitrary controller term.
next_action: Test a rank-two decomposition with two independently certified controllers and quantify the Boolean compatibility/cross-term obstruction before proposing any approximate-rank theorem.
